metadata.article_title: Specific relief to be granted only for enforcing individual civil rights and not for enforcing penal laws.

article.title: Specific relief to be granted only for enforcing individual civil rights and not for enforcing penal laws.
article.content: Specific relief can be granted only for the purpose of enforcing individual civil rights and not for the mere purpose of enforcing a penal law.
article.html:
4Specific relief to be granted only for enforcing individual civil rights and not for enforcing penal laws.

Section 4 · Part I · page 4 of the Act

Specific relief can be granted only for the purpose of enforcing individual civil rights and not for the mere purpose of enforcing a penal law.
